data.name: Afia
data.gender_notes: Afia is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Arabic, Afia means 'life-giver'. In Islamic tradition, it is a name given to a girl, symbolizing the gift of life and nourishment. The name Afia carries the meaning “Life-giving” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Afia usually hope their child will grow to embody life-giving and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Nourishment for the soul, as mentioned in the Hadith, 'The best of names are those which are pleasing to Allah, and the most beautiful names are Luqman, Ali, Ayman, Zainab and Zaynab.' (Sahih Muslim)
data.etymology: Afia belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Life-giving.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Afia total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_arabic.name: عافية
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم عافية من أصل عربي، يعني الصحة والسلامة للإنسان، وقد ورد في القرآن الكريم في عدة مواضع، منها قوله تعالى: 'وإذا مرضت فهي تبرأ'، وقد استخدم هذا الاسم في العديد من الثقافات الإسلامية كتعبير عن الصحة والرفاهية

in_urdu.name: عافیہ
in_urdu.meaning: عافیہ کا مطلب ہے صحت و سلامتی
in_urdu.long_meaning: عافیہ ایک عربی نام ہے جس کا مطلب ہے صحت و سلامتی، یہ نام قرآن کریم میں بھی آیا ہے، جیسے کہ 'وإذا مرضت فهي تبرأ'، یہ نام جنوبی ایشیاء میں اسلامی ثقافت میں صحت و تندرستی کی علامت کے طور پر استعمال ہوتا ہے

in_hindi.name: अफिया
in_hindi.meaning: अफिया का अर्थ है स्वास्थ्य और सलामती
in_hindi.long_meaning: अफिया एक अरबी नाम है जिसका अर्थ है स्वास्थ्य और सलामती, यह नाम कुरआन में भी आया है, जैसे कि 'وإذا مرضت فهي تبرأ', यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में स्वास्थ्य और तंदुरुस्ती की निशानी के रूप में प्रयोग किया जाता है

in_english.name: Afia
in_english.meaning: Afia means health, safety, and well-being
in_english.long_meaning: The name Afia originates from Arabic, meaning health, safety, and well-being. It is derived from the Arabic root 'A-F-Y' which connotes the idea of recovery and wellness. The name appears in the Quran, emphasizing its significance in Islamic tradition. Afia symbolizes good health and is widely used across Muslim cultures to signify blessings of wellness and prosperity

data.cultural_impact: The name Afia carries a deep cultural significance in many Muslim households. The name represents an appreciation and respect for the gift of life, which is a fundamental tenet of the Islamic faith. In many Muslim communities, parents often choose names for their children that reflect Islamic values and surroundings, and Afia is one such name that embodies the essence of life and the act of giving.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Afia holds great significance. According to Islamic teachings, the creation and preservation of life is an act of God. By giving their child the name Afia, parents are acknowledging God's role in the creation and sustenance of life, and expressing their gratitude for the gift of their child. The name also encourages parents and the child to lead a virtuous life, understanding that they are entrusted with the precious gift of life.
